item.title: reel-01-front-desk
item.description:
Clinic enquiries sent at 11pm usually wait until morning. By then, the patient may have booked somewhere else.
This n8n workflow replies in seconds, using only the clinic's own details, logs every lead in Google Sheets and flags urgent ones for staff.
Free clinic enquiry workflow: see the link in bio, or DM me FLOW.
#n8n #automation #aiautomation #clinicmarketing #freelancer #nocode
